title: Capacitor fails above its rated voltage or when a polarised one is reversed

implements.text: The capacitor latches burnt when the voltage across it passes its rating, or when a polarised one is held reversed for 500 ms

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history, ageing and leakage; only the threshold and its dwell are checked

parameterSources.note: the voltage printed on the sleeve; ceramic parts use the lowest stock rating, 16 V
no source; chosen so a brief spike does not burn the part

validation.dataset: src/sim/analog/live-health.test.ts: a capacitor and an inductor in the live solver

operatingRange.evidence: the rated voltages of the stock parts, 6.3 V to 50 V

knownFailureCases: The 500 ms reversed dwell has no source
A real electrolytic vents with a bang, a ceramic cracks; here both are only marked burnt
